summary: Positron Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement: a $2 million line of credit from affiliated investor George Ortiz. Terms include draws up to $500,000 per quarter, 12% fixed interest, interest-only for 12 months, maturity August 13, 2028, and warrants for 300,000 shares at $1.50 (repricing to $1.00 upon default). This is routine financing, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, board action, or deal mechanics involved. Watch for dilution from warrants and credit drawdowns, but no risk-arb angle.
